jellyfin_import.title: Import from Jellyfin
jellyfin_import.help_intro: Bring over users, watch history and audio and subtitle choices from a Jellyfin server. Rustyfin only reads Jellyfin’s data folder.
jellyfin_import.help_mount: Make Jellyfin’s /config folder visible to Rustyfin, read-only. With Docker, add this volume to Rustyfin’s container:
jellyfin_import.help_path: Then enter /import/jellyfin below. Stop Jellyfin first, or import a copy of the folder, so its database doesn’t change during the import.
jellyfin_import.pairs_help: Each pair turns a Jellyfin path into the matching Rustyfin path, so items are found by their files.
jellyfin_import.unpaired: These Jellyfin library folders have no pair, so their items can’t be found by path:
jellyfin_import.action_create: New user with a one-time code

jellyfin_import.into_mine_hint: None of the selected Jellyfin users is matched to your account by name. To bring your own history over, choose your Jellyfin user under “Import into my account”.
jellyfin_import.reason_taken_by_mine: your account gets another Jellyfin user's data

jellyfin_import.counts_from_preview: These counts are from the last Preview. Ticks changed since then count after the next Preview.
